name: David Adegbola
title: Forest bioeconomy, GIS and remote sensing
intro: Sustainable Forest Bioeconomy student at the University of Eastern Finland, looking for GIS, remote sensing and forestry work in Finland.
description: David Adegbola: Sustainable Forest Bioeconomy student at UEF, working towards GIS, remote sensing and forestry roles in Finland.
about: I grew up in Nigeria and came to Finland to study IT at VAMK in Vaasa. A summer contract at UPM Kaukas changed my direction. Watching logs float on Lake Saimaa beside the mill, I started asking where they came from and how the forests behind them are managed. That question took me to Sustainable Forest Bioeconomy at UEF. Now I'm focused on GIS and remote sensing: reading forests from data, and checking what that data means on the ground.
